title: Factory move D: retire the factory from ticks
description:
The deletion half, in the TICKS repo. A separate PR against a separate repo and CI, deliberately not bundled into a ticfac-side tick.

Delete from ticks: internal/factory, internal/gatewaytrace, cloud/factory, cloud/sandbox. Remove cmd/tk/cmd/factory.go and factory_dashboard.go, and the run|stop|status|logs|trace|supervisor subcommands from cloud.go, cloud_logs.go, cloud_trace.go and cloud_supervisor.go. Drop the module-root embeds those leave unused.

Do NOT delete internal/tkcontract. It cannot move: cmd/tk's own version and root contract gate use it.

Do this only once the ticfac side actually works end to end — a deletion before that leaves no way back. Same rule the herd retirement tick follows.

Until this lands, 'extracted' means 'copied', and two codebases drift.
acceptance_criteria: ticks no longer carries the factory tree, the gateway-trace package, the cloud build contexts, or the factory and cloud commands; internal/tkcontract is untouched; ticks builds and its tests pass; the same commands work from the ticfac CLI; the ticfac gate is green.
